objective: Lift AH's all-pair average raw-mass certificate to a symbolic residual class computable from signed incidence statistics without enumerating positive/negative parent pairs.

frozen_symbolic_bound.per_variable: For pivot x let a_x=#positive parents, b_x=#negative parents, A_x=sum widths of positive parents, B_x=sum widths of negative parents. Every non-tautological raw resolvent pair has mass at most |p|+|n|-1, hence pair_mass_x <= b_x*A_x + a_x*B_x - a_x*b_x.
frozen_symbolic_bound.aggregate: Let P_hat=sum_x(b_x*A_x+a_x*B_x-a_x*b_x). Then sum_x RAW_S(x) <= V*S - L - Q2 + P_hat, where Q2=sum_clause |clause|^2.
frozen_symbolic_bound.symbolic_class: Canonical tautology-free bipolar residual CNFs satisfying V*S - L - Q2 + P_hat <= V*T.
frozen_symbolic_bound.existence_consequence: Any formula in the symbolic class has at least one pivot with RAW_S(x)<=T by min<=average, so the frozen post-transition invariant is preserved before NF; exact DP NF can only decrease raw mass.
frozen_symbolic_bound.complexity_contract: a_x,b_x,A_x,B_x,Q2 are computable by a linear scan of explicit clause-literal incidences; no parent-pair enumeration and no SAT truth are used.

secondary_corollary.name: WIDTH_DEGREE_COARSE_BOUND
secondary_corollary.statement: If W=max clause width and Delta=max variable occurrence degree, then P_hat <= floor((2*W-1)*Delta*L/4).
secondary_corollary.role: Diagnostic only; failure of this coarser corollary does not invalidate the primary signed-incidence certificate.

domain.legacy_reachable_roots: Reuse AH's 15 frozen roots and legacy reachability route exactly.

success_condition: The signed-incidence aggregate upper bound is sound and every frozen reachable residual satisfies the symbolic-class inequality with at least one independently replayable admissible raw-DP pivot and no semantic mismatch.
